conclusion: On the untouched Tier-3 long-horizon holdout view (seed 0, zero tuning, 5984.8s), rgdt-v3 passed 9/18 tasks (two_pole 0.8769, unused_token_hold, ae_gan_hold, clockfree_audit, zero_tanh_smoke 0.0030 MAE, mode_hold 1.0000 hq, ring_hold conv=1400, uninterrupted 7500-step ring_extension 300/300 checks, and target_shift_recovery 81/81 live checks min_hq=0.9998), failed 4 tasks (zero_tanh_rail_escape sustained window with final 0.0035 MAE, grid100 prec=0.3080, rotated100 0.2507, staggered100 0.2989, gating all three 14k continuations), and hit the 900s timeout INCOMPLETE on five_word_joint_smoke (gating five_word_joint_hold).
